title: nanotyper: Nanopore amplicon multilocus sequence typing
description: A Snakemake workflow that calls multilocus sequence types from Oxford Nanopore amplicon sequencing of MLST housekeeping genes: per-locus medaka consensus, BLAST allele assignment against a pinned PubMLST snapshot, primer-coverage QC with explicit PASS/NEW_ST/NEW_ALLELE/LOW_COVERAGE/FAIL tiers, and an interactive HTML report. Runs on an ordinary laptop or workstation; batch mode processes up to 96 barcodes per run across many runs with cross-run aggregation and replicate checks. Organism-specific material lives in scheme packs; version 1.0 ships the Escherichia coli Achtman 7-locus scheme. Every analysis writes a provenance record tying its calls to the pipeline version, scheme, database snapshot and tool versions.
